name: @scholarly-editing/parser
description: WebAssembly parser for scholarly editing texts and manuscripts

scripts.build: cd parser-wasm && wasm-pack build --out-dir ../dist --out-name index --target bundler --release && rm -f ../dist/.gitignore ../dist/package.json && cd ..
scripts.build:node: cd parser-wasm && wasm-pack build --out-dir ../dist-node --out-name index --target nodejs --release && rm -f ../dist-node/.gitignore ../dist-node/package.json && cd ..

author: mahmoudkozae <mahmoud.kozae@fu-berlin.de>
